newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thailand's IFCT mandates US$150 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's IFCT mandates US$150 mln FRN.

text.p: Industrial Finance Corp of Thailand (IFCT) has mandated BA Asia and Nomura International (Hong Kong) Ltd to arrange a floating rate note issue, BA Asia said on Monday.
The issue will be US$150 million in size and will mature on April 22, 2002. There are no puts or calls.
The notes will pay a coupon of 30 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. They will be priced at par but the fixed re-offer price has not yet been set.
Fees will total 35 basis points. A group of co-lead managers and co-managers is being formed.
The notes will be launched off the borrower's US$3 billion global medium-term note programme. IFCT is rated A3 by Moody's Investors Service and single-A by Standard & Poor's Corp.
The issue is expected to be launched bond-style in the last week of May.
